answer:
You can now change the monthly limit yourself. It's set to 12 000 kr. Open the app's settings (More › App Settings) and edit "Monthly limit". The app updates straight away.

I also fixed a few other things in the app:
- **Amounts:** The app wasn't reading your "Amt" column, so your expenses weren't showing. It reads that column now.
- **Controls:** I added labels to the input fields. I made the controls taller so they're easier to tap on a phone. I also changed the Add button's colours so the text is easier to read.

The app's checks now pass.
